name: Etholate 250mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET

ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET contains Etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to manage bleeding. It reduces bleeding time and blood loss. ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat etc, to manage bleeding.

It also helps to reduce bleeding in or from the nose (epistaxis), gums (gingivitis), urine (haematuria), stools (melena), etc. ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET is also recommended for use by females to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device present).

Before starting with ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET, your doctor may advise you to take tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman/girl suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET is not recommended to take if you are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the synthesis of haemoglobin is not proper). ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET must be taken with caution if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases.

ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET is also generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children. The most common side effects of taking ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET Works

ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET contains Etamsylate, which is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of blood clots during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.
usageDetails:
How to use ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET

Take ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor. Generally, it is advised to swallow the medicine with a glass of water Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Reduction in blood count of platelets which increases the risk of bleeding and bruising

warnings.details: ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use by pregnant women. However, caution is advised if recommended by your considering the risks and benefits of your existing condition. Inform your doctor, if you are pregnant or planning to get pregnant. Consult your doctor before taking ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET.

ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding mothers, unless it is necessary. A decision must be made whether to discontinue breastfeeding or to discontinue from ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET therapy considering the risks and benefits. Consult your doctor before taking ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET.
ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before taking ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET.
ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients suffering from kidney failure. Consult your doctor before taking ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET.
ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients suffering from liver dysfunction. (Liver failure). Consult your doctor before taking ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET.
Do not take ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET if you are allergic to Etamsylate or any other antihemorrhagic drugs (ex. Tranexamic acid, aprotinin). Consult your doctor before taking ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET.

Others

ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET is not recommended to take if you are having:

Porphyria (blood disorder where the synthesis of haemoglobin is not proper)

Use in pediatrics:

ETHOLATE 250MG TABLET should be used with caution in children. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Tenacid MF Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TENACID MF TABLET

TENACID MF TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

TENACID MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. TENACID MF TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

TENACID MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of TENACID MF TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

warnings.details: TENACID MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, only if recommended by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking it.
TENACID MF TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers, only if recommended by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines. If you are experiencing improper vision, dizziness etc.
Avoid consuming alcohol while using TENACID MF TABLET, as it may worsen your existing condition and increases the risk of bleeding in the stomach. Consult your doctor before taking it.
TENACID MF TABLET is not recommended for use if are having severe kidney disease such as kidney failure etc. Consult your doctor before taking it.
TENACID MF TABLET should be used with caution if you are having liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TENACID MF TABLET if you are allergic to Tranexamic acid and Mefenamic acid.

Others

TENACID MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Thrombosis – blood clot or blockage in blood vessels
Fits or seizure
Excessive bleeding disorder such as consumption coagulopathy (DIC)

Before taking TENACID MF TABLET, inform your physician if you have:

Blood in the urine
Uncontrolled bleeding
Irregular menstrual period
Angioneurotic oedema (HANO)

Use in Pediatrics:

The safety of the usage of TENACID MF TABLET in children is not known. Consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

TENACID MF TABLET should be used with caution in an elderly patient. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

name: Texakind Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TEXAKIND TABLET

TEXAKIND TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.

TEXAKIND TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.

Before taking TEXAKIND TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).

TEXAKIND TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking TEXAKIND TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of TEXAKIND TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking TEXAKIND TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

Bleeding from the nose
Bleeding inside the digestive system (gastrointestinal system, Ex. inflammatory bowel disease))

mechanismOfAction:
How TEXAKIND TABLET Works

TEXAKIND TABLET manages bleeding by blocking the plasminogen from binding with fibrin which results in bleeding. As a result, it manages and controls bleeding associated with various conditions.
usageDetails:
How to use TEXAKIND TABLET

Always take TEXAKIND TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not take this medicine before your period has started as it will not work properly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency of TEXAKIND TABLET for you depending upon age, weight and disease conditions.
sideEffects: Impaired vision (especially color), blood clot in the eye

Pain or swelling in the arms or legs

warnings.details: TEXAKIND TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant or think you may be pregnant before using TEXAKIND TABLET.
TEXAKIND TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking TEXAKIND TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness after taking TEXAKIND TABLET.

TEXAKIND TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. TEXAKIND TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney impairment and your doctor may adjust the dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TEXAKIND TABLET.
No dose adjustment is required in patients with hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not take TEXAKIND TABLET if you are allergic to Tranexamic Acid or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TEXAKIND TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (arteries of the lungs are blocked by clot). Consult your doctor before taking TEXAKIND TABLET.
Safety and effectiveness of TEXAKIND TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
TEXAKIND TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods). Consult your doctor before taking TEXAKIND TABLET.

Others

TEXAKIND TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have a blood clotting disorder (consumption coagulopathy)
Have history of fits or seizure disorder
Have an irregular menstrual cycle
Have acquired disturbances of color vision
Have history of venous or arterial thrombosis (blood clot in artery/veins)
Have deep vein thrombosis, cerebral thrombosis (blood clot of cerebral vein in brain)
Have subarachnoid hemorrhage (bleeding in space between brain and tissue covering the brain)
Have blood in urine between periods

Before taking TEXAKIND TABLET, inform your physician if you:

Have changes in normal bleeding pattern
Have family history of endometrial cancer
Have abnormal bleeding between the periods
Have bleeding during or after sexual intercourse
Have premenstrual pain or lower abdominal pain
Have bleeding after menopause
Have obstruction of the urinary tract
Are at a risk for the formation of a blood clot
Are diabetic
Are overweight
Have polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)

name: Trapic 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRAPIC 500MG TABLET

TRAPIC 500MG TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.

TRAPIC 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.

Before taking TRAPIC 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).

TRAPIC 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking TRAPIC 500MG TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of TRAPIC 500MG TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking TRAPIC 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ANTHOCYN TX TABLET

ANTHOCYN TX TABLET contains Glutathione and Tranexamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antioxidants and Antifibrinolytics. It is used to manage melasma, chloasma, UV induced hyperpigmentation and post inflammatory hyperpigmentation.

It helps in reducing the amount of skin-darkening pigment called melanin in the skin. It also lightens the darkened skin patches and spots and helps in the detoxification of the skin.

Before taking ANTHOCYN TX TABLET inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, lung or heart diseases.

It is not known whether this medicine is safe to be taken by pregnant or breastfeeding women. Consult with your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects are nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, dizziness, and hypotension. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.

name: Hemsyl Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About HEMSYL INJECTION

HEMSYL INJECTION contains Ethamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihemorrhagic drugs. It is used to manage bleeding from the blood vessels and to manage bleeding before or after an operation.

Ethamsylate exerts hemostatic action by improving platelet adhesiveness and restoring capillary (blood vessels) resistance. It decreases bleeding time and increases platelet clumping which reduces capillary bleeding and improves capillary wall stability. Before the management, your doctor might want to do certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

HEMSYL INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have porphyria (defect in the synthesis of haemoglobin) or bronchial asthma. Before receiving HEMSYL INJECTION inform your doctor if you have hypotension or unstable blood pressure. HEMSYL INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual effects while receiving HEMSYL INJECTION.

HEMSYL INJECTION exerts hemostatic action by improving platelet adhesiveness and restoring capillary (blood vessels) resistance. introduction:
Introduction About MELANO TX 250 TABLET

MELANO TX 250 TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.       

MELANO TX 250 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.  

Before taking MELANO TX 250 TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).   

MELANO TX 250 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking MELANO TX 250 TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of MELANO TX 250 TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking MELANO TX 250 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

name: Cosklot 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About COSKLOT 500MG TABLET

COSKLOT 500MG TABLET contains etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to reduce bleeding and control blood loss. It is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat, etc. to manage bleeding. It is also used to manage conditions such as blood in the urine, blood vomit, bleeding from the nose, blood in the stools, bleeding from the gums, etc.

In females, COSKLOT 500MG TABLET is used to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device) in the absence of any organ defects.

Before starting with COSKLOT 500MG TABLET, your doctor might want to do a few tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

COSKLOT 500MG TABLET is not recommended to take if you are allergic to etamsylate or sulfites, have bronchial asthma or are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the formation of haemoglobin is not proper). Before taking COSKLOT 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects.

COSKLOT 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers or children. The most common side effects of taking COSKLOT 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms are worsening.
uses: Manages, manages and controls bleeding in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of COSKLOT 500MG TABLET
Manages, manages and controls bleeding in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How COSKLOT 500MG TABLET Works

COSKLOT 500MG TABLET is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of the blood clot during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.
usageDetails:
How to use COSKLOT 500MG TABLET

Take COSKLOT 500MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor. It is advised to swallow the medicine with a glass of water and should be taken preferably with meals. During surgical procedures, it is advised to take COSKLOT 500MG TABLET on an empty stomach. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Reduction in blood count of platelets which increases the risk of bleeding and bruising

Clots in blood vessels (thromboembolism)
Getting infections more likely (due to reduced count of white blood cells)

Allergic reactions
Fever

name: TRANESMA Tablet 30's
introduction:
Introduction About TRANESMA TABLET

TRANESMA TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.       

TRANESMA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.  

Before taking TRANESMA TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).   

TRANESMA TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking TRANESMA TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of TRANESMA TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking TRANESMA TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TRANESMA TABLET Works

TRANESMA TABLET manages bleeding by blocking the plasminogen from binding with fibrin which results in bleeding. As a result, it manages and controls bleeding associated with various conditions.
usageDetails:
How to use TRANESMA TABLET

Take TRANESMA TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not take this medicine before your period has started as it will not work properly. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration and frequency of TRANESMA TABLET for you depending upon age, weight and disease conditions.

warnings.details: TRANESMA TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered clearly necessary. Inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant or think you may be pregnant before using TRANESMA TABLET.
TRANESMA TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking TRANESMA TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness after taking TRANESMA TABLET.

TRANESMA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. TRANESMA TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney impairment and your doctor may adjust the dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TRANESMA TABLET.
No dose adjustment is required in patients with hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not take TRANESMA TABLET if you are allergic to Tranexamic Acid or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TRANESMA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (arteries of the lungs are blocked by clot). Consult your doctor before taking TRANESMA TABLET.

Others

Have a blood clotting disorder (consumption coagulopathy)
Have history of fits or seizure disorder
Have an irregular menstrual cycle
Have acquired disturbances of color vision
Have history of venous or arterial thrombosis (blood clot in artery/veins)
Have deep vein thrombosis, cerebral thrombosis (blood clot of cerebral vein in brain)
Have subarachnoid hemorrhage (bleeding in space between brain and tissue covering the brain)
Have blood in urine between periods

Before taking TRANESMA TABLET inform your physician if you:

Have changes in normal bleeding pattern

Have abnormal bleeding between the periods
Have bleeding during or after sexual intercourse
Have premenstrual pain or lower abdominal pain
Have bleeding after menopause
Have obstruction of the urinary tract
Are at a risk for the formation of a blood clot
Are diabetic
Are overweight
Have polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)

Use in pediatrics:

Safety and effectiveness of TRANESMA TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet. Consult your child’s doctor for advice. 

Use in geriatrics:

TRANESMA TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods). Consult your doctor before taking TRANESMA TABLET.

Itchy, red or swollen skin
Serious blood clots
Pain or feelings of heaviness in the chest
Pain or swelling in the arms or legs
Sudden shortness of breath, fainting
Coughing up blood

PYNOMAX TX TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding women only if advised by the doctor as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking PYNOMAX TX TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness after taking PYNOMAX TX TABLET.

PYNOMAX TX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. PYNOMAX TX TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney impairment and your doctor may adjust the dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor for advice before taking PYNOMAX TX TABLET.

PYNOMAX TX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pulmonary embolism (arteries of the lungs are blocked by clot). Consult your doctor before taking PYNOMAX TX TABLET.

Others

PYNOMAX TX TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have a blood clotting disorder (consumption coagulopathy)
Have history of fits or seizure disorder
Have an irregular menstrual cycle
Have acquired disturbances of color vision
Have history of venous or arterial thrombosis (blood clot in artery/veins)
Have deep vein thrombosis, cerebral thrombosis (blood clot of cerebral vein in brain)
Have subarachnoid hemorrhage (bleeding in space between brain and tissue covering the brain)
Have blood in urine between periods

Before taking PYNOMAX TX TABLET inform your physician if you:

Have changes in normal bleeding pattern
Have family history of endometrial cancer
Have abnormal bleeding between the periods
Have bleeding during or after sexual intercourse
Have premenstrual pain or lower abdominal pain
Have bleeding after menopause
Have obstruction of the urinary tract
Are at a risk for the formation of a blood clot
Are diabetic
Are overweight
Have polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)

Use in pediatrics:

Safety and effectiveness of PYNOMAX TX TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet. Consult your child’s doctor for advice. 

Use in geriatrics:

PYNOMAX TX TABLET is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods). Consult your doctor before taking PYNOMAX TX TABLET.

name: Etholate 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET

ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET contains etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to reduce bleeding and control blood loss. It is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat, etc. to manage bleeding. It is also used to manage conditions such as blood in the urine, blood vomit, bleeding from the nose, blood in the stools, bleeding from the gums, etc.

In females, ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET is used to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device) in the absence of any organ defects.

Before starting with ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET, your doctor might want to do a few tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET is not recommended to take if you are allergic to etamsylate or sulfites, have bronchial asthma or are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the formation of haemoglobin is not proper). Before taking ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects.

ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers or children. The most common side effects of taking ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms are worsening.
uses: Manages, manages and controls bleeding in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET
Manages, manages and controls bleeding in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET Works

ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of the blood clot during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.
usageDetails:
How to use ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET

Take ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor. It is advised to swallow the medicine with a glass of water and should be taken preferably with meals. During surgical procedures, it is advised to take ETHOLATE 500MG TABLET on an empty stomach. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

name: Redotrex MF Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About REDOTREX MF TABLET

REDOTREX MF TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

REDOTREX MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. REDOTREX MF TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

REDOTREX MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of REDOTREX MF TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MELANO TX OD TABLET

MELANO TX OD TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.

MELANO TX OD TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.

Before taking MELANO TX OD TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).

MELANO TX OD TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking MELANO TX OD TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SYLATE 500MG TABLET

SYLATE 500MG TABLET contains etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to reduce bleeding and control blood loss. It is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat, etc. to manage bleeding. It is also used to manage conditions such as blood in the urine, blood vomit, bleeding from the nose, blood in the stools, bleeding from the gums, etc.

In females, SYLATE 500MG TABLET is used to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device) in the absence of any organ defects.

Before starting with SYLATE 500MG TABLET, your doctor might want to do a few tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

SYLATE 500MG TABLET is not recommended to take if you are allergic to etamsylate or sulfites, have bronchial asthma or are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the formation of haemoglobin is not proper). Before taking SYLATE 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects.

SYLATE 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers or children. The most common side effects of taking SYLATE 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms are worsening.

usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How SYLATE 500MG TABLET Works

SYLATE 500MG TABLET is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of the blood clot during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.
usageDetails:
How to use SYLATE 500MG TABLET

Take SYLATE 500MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor. It is advised to swallow the medicine with a glass of water and should be taken preferably with meals. During surgical procedures, it is advised to take SYLATE 500MG TABLET on an empty stomach. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAMELO TABLET

TRAMELO TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

TRAMELO TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. TRAMELO TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

TRAMELO TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of TRAMELO TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRAMELO TABLET

To manage, control and manage bleeding and pain in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding (Menorrhagia), Dysfunctional uterine bleeding (DUB), tooth removal, nose bleeds etc.
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAMELO TABLET Works

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). As a result, TRAMELO TABLET management controls and manages severe loss of blood and pain.

introduction:
Introduction About TRENAXA INJECTION

TRENAXA INJECTION contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, gastrointestinal bleeding (bleeding in digestive tract, anywhere from the throat to rectum), bleeding due to thrombolytic therapy (medicine that is used to breakdown blood clots) and after having surgeries (such as ear, nose, throat, prostate gland, urinary tract, gynecological, abdominal or heart surgery) in adults and children above one year of age.

TRENAXA INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment, blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy (condition affecting the blood’s ability to clot and stop the bleeding) or history of seizures (fits). Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving TRENAXA INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have blood in the urine, are at risk of having a blood clot, excessive clotting or bleeding throughout the body (disseminated intravascular coagulation).

TRENAXA INJECTION is not recommended for use in the first trimester of pregnancy and in breast-feeding women. It should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor. TRENAXA INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with the evidence of renal failure.

The most common side effects of receiving TRENAXA INJECTION are nausea or vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

TRENAXA INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it passes through breast milk. Consult your doctor for advice.

TRENAXA INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney impairment. Your doctor may adjust the dose depending upon the kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving TRENAXA INJECTION.
TRENAXA INJECTION can be used with caution in patients with liver impairment. Consult your doctor before receiving TRENAXA INJECTION.
Do not receive TRENAXA INJECTION if you are allergic to Tranexamic acid or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TRENAXA INJECTION should be used with caution in children above 1 year of age. Your child’s doctor will adjust the dose based on the bodyweight of the child. Consult child’s doctor for advice before administration of TRENAXA INJECTION.
TRENAXA INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with the evidence of renal failure. Consult your doctor before receiving TRENAXA INJECTION.

Others

TRENAXA INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy (condition affecting the blood’s ability to clot and stop the bleeding)
Have history of seizures (fits)

Before receiving TRENAXA INJECTION, inform your physician if you:

Have blood in the urine (which may lead to urinary tract obstruction)
Are at risk of having a blood clot
Have excessive clotting or bleeding throughout the body (disseminated intravascular coagulation)

name: Xamic MF Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About XAMIC MF TABLET

XAMIC MF TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

XAMIC MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. XAMIC MF TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

XAMIC MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of XAMIC MF TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage, control and manage bleeding and pain in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding (Menorrhagia), Dysfunctional uterine bleeding (DUB), tooth removal, nose bleeds etc.

As a result, XAMIC MF TABLET management controls and manages severe loss of blood and pain.

warnings.details: XAMIC MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, only if recommended by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking it.
XAMIC MF TABLET should be used with caution in breastfeeding mothers, only if recommended by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines. If you are experiencing improper vision, dizziness etc.
Avoid consuming alcohol while using XAMIC MF TABLET, as it may worsen your existing condition and increases the risk of bleeding in the stomach. Consult your doctor before taking it.
XAMIC MF TABLET is not recommended for use if are having severe kidney disease such as kidney failure etc. Consult your doctor before taking it.
XAMIC MF TABLET should be used with caution if you are having liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take XAMIC MF TABLET if you are allergic to Tranexamic acid and Mefenamic acid.

Others

XAMIC MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Thrombosis – blood clot or blockage in blood vessels
Fits or seizure
Excessive bleeding disorder such as consumption coagulopathy (DIC)

Before taking XAMIC MF TABLET, inform your physician if you have:

Blood in the urine
Uncontrolled bleeding
Irregular menstrual period
Angioneurotic oedema (HANO)

Use in Pediatrics:

The safety of the usage of XAMIC MF TABLET in children is not known. Consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

XAMIC MF TABLET should be used with caution in an elderly patient. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

name: Pause XT Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PAUSE XT TABLET

PAUSE XT TABLET contains a combination of Tranexamic Acid, Citrus Bioflavonoids, Menadione, and Tribasic Calcium Phosphate which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytic agents. It is used to control or reduce excessive bleeding during periods or after surgery.

PAUSE XT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having active or history of thromboembolic disease (Ex. deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, or cerebral thrombosis including retinal vein or artery occlusion, thrombogenic valvular disease, thrombogenic cardiac rhythm disease, or hypercoagulopathy).

Before taking PAUSE XT TABLET inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcer, liver disease or blood clotting problems. PAUSE XT TABLET is generally not recommended to use in pregnant women and it should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. PAUSE XT TABLET is not recommended for use in premenarcheal girls and postmenopausal women.

PAUSE XT TABLET should be used with caution in female adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effects of PAUSE XT TABLET are headaches, sinus and nasal problems, back pain, stomach pain, pain in the muscles or joints, anemia, and fatigue. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or do not improve.

How PAUSE XT TABLET Works

PAUSE XT TABLET contains a combination of Tranexamic Acid, Citrus Bioflavonoids, Menadione, and Tribasic Calcium Phosphate, where Tranexamic acid is an antifibrinolytic agent that works by forming blood clots normally to reduce bleeding during periods, or after surgery. Tribasic Calcium Phosphate and Citrus Bioflavonoid provide essential nutrients. Menadione is a blood clotting vitamin that controls excessive bleeding.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of PAUSE XT TABLET for you depending on your age, disease condition, and body weight.

name: Trapic 650mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TRAPIC 650MG TABLET

TRAPIC 650MG TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.       

TRAPIC 650MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.  

Before taking TRAPIC 650MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).   

TRAPIC 650MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking TRAPIC 650MG TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of TRAPIC 650MG TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking TRAPIC 650MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

name: Pause Injection 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About PAUSE INJECTION

PAUSE INJECTION contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, gastrointestinal bleeding (bleeding in digestive tract, anywhere from the throat to rectum), bleeding due to thrombolytic therapy (medicine that is used to breakdown blood clots) and after having surgeries (such as ear, nose, throat, prostate gland, urinary tract, gynecological, abdominal or heart surgery) in adults and children above one year of age.

PAUSE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment, blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy (condition affecting the blood’s ability to clot and stop the bleeding) or history of seizures (fits). Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving PAUSE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have blood in the urine, are at risk of having a blood clot, excessive clotting or bleeding throughout the body (disseminated intravascular coagulation).

PAUSE INJECTION is not recommended for use in the first trimester of pregnancy and in breast-feeding women. It should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor. PAUSE INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with the evidence of renal failure.

The most common side effects of receiving PAUSE INJECTION are nausea or vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

PAUSE INJECTION manages bleeding by blocking the plasminogen from binding with fibrin which results in bleeding. As a result, it manages and controls bleeding associated with various factors.

PAUSE INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, frequency and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Sylate Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About SYLATE INJECTION

SYLATE INJECTION contains Ethamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihemorrhagic drugs. It is used to manage bleeding from the blood vessels and to manage bleeding before or after an operation.

Ethamsylate exerts hemostatic action by improving platelet adhesiveness and restoring capillary (blood vessels) resistance. It decreases bleeding time and increases platelet clumping which reduces capillary bleeding and improves capillary wall stability. Before the management, your doctor might want to do certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

SYLATE INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have porphyria (defect in the synthesis of haemoglobin) or bronchial asthma. Before receiving SYLATE INJECTION inform your doctor if you have hypotension or unstable blood pressure. SYLATE INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual effects while receiving SYLATE INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About HEMSYL 500MG TABLET

HEMSYL 500MG TABLET contains etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to reduce bleeding and control blood loss. It is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat, etc. to manage bleeding. It is also used to manage conditions such as blood in the urine, blood vomit, bleeding from the nose, blood in the stools, bleeding from the gums, etc.

In females, HEMSYL 500MG TABLET is used to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device) in the absence of any organ defects.

Before starting with HEMSYL 500MG TABLET, your doctor might want to do a few tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

HEMSYL 500MG TABLET is not recommended to take if you are allergic to etamsylate or sulfites, have bronchial asthma or are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the formation of haemoglobin is not proper). Before taking HEMSYL 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects.

HEMSYL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers or children. The most common side effects of taking HEMSYL 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms are worsening.
uses: Manages, manages and controls bleeding in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of HEMSYL 500MG TABLET
Manages, manages and controls bleeding in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How HEMSYL 500MG TABLET Works

HEMSYL 500MG TABLET is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of the blood clot during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.
usageDetails:
How to use HEMSYL 500MG TABLET

Take HEMSYL 500MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor. It is advised to swallow the medicine with a glass of water and should be taken preferably with meals. During surgical procedures, it is advised to take HEMSYL 500MG TABLET on an empty stomach. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About TRANEXAREN TABLET

TRANEXAREN TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

TRANEXAREN TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. TRANEXAREN TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

TRANEXAREN TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of TRANEXAREN TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

name: Sylate 250mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SYLATE 250MG TABLET

SYLATE 250MG TABLET contains Etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to manage bleeding. It reduces bleeding time and blood loss. SYLATE 250MG TABLET is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat etc, to manage bleeding.

It also helps to reduce bleeding in or from the nose (epistaxis), gums (gingivitis), urine (haematuria), stools (melena), etc. SYLATE 250MG TABLET is also recommended for use by females to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device present).

Before starting with SYLATE 250MG TABLET, your doctor may advise you to take tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman/girl suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

SYLATE 250MG TABLET is not recommended to take if you are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the synthesis of haemoglobin is not proper). SYLATE 250MG TABLET must be taken with caution if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases.

SYLATE 250MG TABLET is also generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children. The most common side effects of taking SYLATE 250MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Manage and manages bleeding
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYLATE 250MG TABLET
Manage and manages bleeding
mechanismOfAction:
How SYLATE 250MG TABLET Works

SYLATE 250MG TABLET contains Etamsylate, which is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of blood clots during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.
usageDetails:
How to use SYLATE 250MG TABLET

Take SYLATE 250MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor. Generally, it is advised to swallow the medicine with a glass of water Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Reduction in blood count of platelets which increases the risk of bleeding and bruising

Clots in blood vessels (thromboembolism)
Getting infections more likely (due to reduced count of white blood cells)
Reduction in blood count of platelets which increases the risk of bleeding and bruising
Increased frequency of getting infections

SYLATE 250MG TABLET does not affect your ability to drive or operate machines. Consult your doctor before taking SYLATE 250MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAM MF TABLET

TRAM MF TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

TRAM MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. TRAM MF TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

TRAM MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of TRAM MF TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About TRANLOK 500MG TABLET

TRANLOK 500MG TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.

TRANLOK 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.

Before taking TRANLOK 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).

TRANLOK 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking TRANLOK 500MG TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of TRANLOK 500MG TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking TRANLOK 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET

ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET contains etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to reduce bleeding and control blood loss. It is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat, etc. to manage bleeding. It is also used to manage conditions such as blood in the urine, blood vomit, bleeding from the nose, blood in the stools, bleeding from the gums, etc.

In females, ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET is used to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device) in the absence of any organ defects.

Before starting with ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET, your doctor might want to do a few tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET is not recommended to take if you are allergic to etamsylate or sulfites, have bronchial asthma or are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the formation of haemoglobin is not proper). Before taking ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects.

ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers or children. The most common side effects of taking ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms are worsening.

How ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET Works

ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of the blood clot during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.

During surgical procedures, it is advised to take ETHAMCIP 500MG TABLET on an empty stomach. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About TRANOSTAT MF TABLET

TRANOSTAT MF TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

TRANOSTAT MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. TRANOSTAT MF TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

TRANOSTAT MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of TRANOSTAT MF TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About DEPIMED TX TABLET

DEPIMED TX TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.

DEPIMED TX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.

Before taking DEPIMED TX TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).

DEPIMED TX TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking DEPIMED TX TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of DEPIMED TX TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking DEPIMED TX TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ETHASYL 500MG TABLET

ETHASYL 500MG TABLET contains etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to reduce bleeding and control blood loss. It is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat, etc. to manage bleeding. It is also used to manage conditions such as blood in the urine, blood vomit, bleeding from the nose, blood in the stools, bleeding from the gums, etc.

In females, ETHASYL 500MG TABLET is used to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device) in the absence of any organ defects.

Before starting with ETHASYL 500MG TABLET, your doctor might want to do a few tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

ETHASYL 500MG TABLET is not recommended to take if you are allergic to etamsylate or sulfites, have bronchial asthma or are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the formation of haemoglobin is not proper). Before taking ETHASYL 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases to avoid unwanted side effects.

ETHASYL 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women, breastfeeding mothers or children. The most common side effects of taking ETHASYL 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms are worsening.

How ETHASYL 500MG TABLET Works

ETHASYL 500MG TABLET is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of the blood clot during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.

Take ETHASYL 500MG TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor. It is advised to swallow the medicine with a glass of water and should be taken preferably with meals. During surgical procedures, it is advised to take ETHASYL 500MG TABLET on an empty stomach. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About ETOSYS MF TABLET

ETOSYS MF TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

ETOSYS MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. ETOSYS MF TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

ETOSYS MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of ETOSYS MF TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

name: Texakind Injection 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About TEXAKIND INJECTION

TEXAKIND INJECTION contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, gastrointestinal bleeding (bleeding in digestive tract, anywhere from the throat to rectum), bleeding due to thrombolytic therapy (medicine that is used to breakdown blood clots) and after having surgeries (such as ear, nose, throat, prostate gland, urinary tract, gynecological, abdominal or heart surgery) in adults and children above one year of age.

TEXAKIND INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment, blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy (condition affecting the blood’s ability to clot and stop the bleeding) or history of seizures (fits). Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving TEXAKIND INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have blood in the urine, are at risk of having a blood clot, excessive clotting or bleeding throughout the body (disseminated intravascular coagulation).

TEXAKIND INJECTION is not recommended for use in the first trimester of pregnancy and in breast-feeding women. It should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor. TEXAKIND INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with the evidence of renal failure.

The most common side effects of receiving TEXAKIND INJECTION are nausea or vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

TRENAXA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.
