TRENAXA 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking TRENAXA 500MG TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of TRENAXA 500MG TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking TRENAXA 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About CLOSTOP SRX TABLET

CLOSTOP SRX TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

CLOSTOP SRX TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. CLOSTOP SRX TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

CLOSTOP SRX TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of CLOSTOP SRX TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage, control and manage bleeding and pain in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding (Menorrhagia), Dysfunctional uterine bleeding (DUB), tooth removal, nose bleeds etc.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEGABLOCK MF TABLET Works

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). As a result, MEGABLOCK MF TABLET management controls and manages severe loss of blood and pain.

name: ETHORED 250 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ETHORED 250 TABLET

ETHORED 250 TABLET contains Etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to manage bleeding. It reduces bleeding time and blood loss. ETHORED 250 TABLET is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat etc, to manage bleeding.

It also helps to reduce bleeding in or from the nose (epistaxis), gums (gingivitis), urine (haematuria), stools (melena), etc. ETHORED 250 TABLET is also recommended for use by females to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device present).

Before starting with ETHORED 250 TABLET, your doctor may advise you to take tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman/girl suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

ETHORED 250 TABLET is not recommended to take if you are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the synthesis of haemoglobin is not proper). ETHORED 250 TABLET must be taken with caution if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases.

ETHORED 250 TABLET is also generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children. The most common side effects of taking ETHORED 250 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Manage and manages bleeding
usesDetails:
Uses Of ETHORED 250 TABLET
Manage and manages bleeding
mechanismOfAction:
How ETHORED 250 TABLET Works

ETHORED 250 TABLET contains Etamsylate, which is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of blood clots during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.
usageDetails:
How to use ETHORED 250 TABLET

Take ETHORED 250 TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor. Generally, it is advised to swallow the medicine with a glass of water Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.
sideEffects: Pain and discomfort in the stomach
Getting infections more likely (due to reduced count of white blood cells)
Reduction in blood count of platelets which increases the risk of bleeding and bruising

name: Botroclot Topical Solution 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About BOTROCLOT TOPICAL SOLUTION

Botroclot Topical Solution is an anticoagulant which is used to arrest bleeding in various conditions such as capillary bleeding, tissue oozing, nose bleeds (epistaxis), surgical bleeds (circumcision, hysterectomy, tonsillectomy, caesarean section etc), or dental extractions. It contains Haemocoagulase as an active ingredient which promotes blood coagulation.

Haemocoagulase helps in arresting bleeding by accelerating the formation of a blood clot. This way it manages excess blood loss and complications that may arise due to excessive bleeding.

Use Botroclot topical solution as directed by your doctor. It is for external use only. Apply five to ten drops or a sufficient amount to cover the wound. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage. Consult your doctor immediately in case you experience any side effects or allergic reactions after using it.
sideEffectsDetails:

Botroclot topical solution may cause some side effects in a few individuals, therefore, consult your doctor immediately in case you experience any side effects or allergic reactions after using it.

name: PYNOMAX OD Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PYNOMAX OD TABLET

PYNOMAX OD TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.

PYNOMAX OD TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.

Before taking PYNOMAX OD TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).

PYNOMAX OD TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking PYNOMAX OD TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of PYNOMAX OD TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking PYNOMAX OD TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

name: Cosklot MF Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About COSKLOT MF TABLET

COSKLOT MF TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

COSKLOT MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. COSKLOT MF TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

COSKLOT MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of COSKLOT MF TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.
uses: To manage, control and manage bleeding and pain in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding (Menorrhagia), Dysfunctional uterine bleeding (DUB), tooth removal, nose bleeds etc.

PAUSERA 500MG TABLET contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, bleeding inside the digestive system (Ex. inflammatory bowel disease), bleeding from the nose, blood in urine (not caused by the kidney (renal parenchyma)), control bleeding after dental extraction in patients with coagulopathies and after cervix surgery.

PAUSERA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy, kidney disease, fits or seizure disorder, irregular menstrual cycle, acquired disturbances of color vision, venous or arterial thrombosis, active thromboembolic diseases such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism and cerebral thrombosis, subarachnoid hemorrhage and blood in urine during periods.

Before taking PAUSERA 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you had or have changes in normal bleeding pattern, family history of endometrial cancer, abnormal bleeding between periods, bleeding during or after sexual intercourse, premenstrual pain, lower abdominal pain, bleeding after menopause, are at risk of having a blood clot, diabetic, overweight, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).

PAUSERA 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking PAUSERA 500MG TABLET. Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Safety and effectiveness of PAUSERA 500MG TABLET in children and adolescents below 18 years of age has not been established yet and it is not recommended for use in elderly women after menopause (stoppage of periods).  

The most common side effects of taking PAUSERA 500MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, tiredness and stomach pain. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About TRENAXA MF TABLET

TRENAXA MF TABLET contains a combination of Mefenamic acid and Tranexamic acid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and antifibrinolytics. It helps to stop/arrest bleeding and relieve pain and swelling from various parts of the body. It is used to manage, control and manage heavy menstrual bleeding (menorrhagia) and menstrual pain, bleeding from the nose or eyes, following a tooth extraction, prostate surgery etc.

Tranexamic acid works by managing the breakdown of blood clots by blocking the interaction of plasminogen with fibrin. Mefenamic acid works by managing the release of a chemical messenger called prostaglandin by inhibiting an enzyme called cyclooxygenase that causes fever, pain and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Your doctor may suggest you take relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition.

TRENAXA MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you have severe kidney disease or failure, blood clots (thrombosis), abnormal body movements such as fits or seizures, an abnormal or excessive bleeding disorder (consumptive coagulopathy), etc. TRENAXA MF TABLET should be used with caution. Inform your doctor if you have blood in the urine, uncontrolled bleeding, blood clots throughout your body, irregular menstruation, mild to moderate kidney or liver disease, angioneurotic oedema (HANO), etc.

TRENAXA MF TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and nursing mothers and only if prescribed by a doctor. The most common side effects of TRENAXA MF TABLET are feeling sick, vomiting, having a headache, having an abnormal heartbeat, having changes in blood pressure, having difficulty urinating, having urine leaks, etc. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET

STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET contains Etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to manage bleeding. It reduces bleeding time and blood loss. STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat etc, to manage bleeding.

It also helps to reduce bleeding in or from the nose (epistaxis), gums (gingivitis), urine (haematuria), stools (melena), etc. STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET is also recommended for use by females to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device present).

Before starting with STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET, your doctor may advise you to take tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman/girl suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET is not recommended to take if you are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the synthesis of haemoglobin is not proper). STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET must be taken with caution if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases.

STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET is also generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children. The most common side effects of taking STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse or persist.

How STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET Works

STYPTOVIT E 250 TABLET contains Etamsylate, which is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of blood clots during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.

Introduction About STERSYL 250 INJECTION

STERSYL 250 INJECTION contains Ethamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihemorrhagic drugs. It is used to manage bleeding from the blood vessels and to manage bleeding before or after an operation.

Ethamsylate exerts hemostatic action by improving platelet adhesiveness and restoring capillary (blood vessels) resistance. It decreases bleeding time and increases platelet clumping which reduces capillary bleeding and improves capillary wall stability. Before the management, your doctor might want to do certain blood tests to understand your existing condition.

STERSYL 250 INJECTION is not recommended for use if you have porphyria (defect in the synthesis of haemoglobin) or bronchial asthma. Before receiving STERSYL 250 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have hypotension or unstable blood pressure. STERSYL 250 INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual effects while receiving STERSYL 250 INJECTION.

It should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor. TRANCE 500 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with the evidence of renal failure.

The most common side effects of receiving TRANCE 500 INJECTION are nausea or vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

name: VINTOR 2000 Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About VINTOR 2000 INJECTION

VINTOR 2000 INJECTION contains Epoetin Alfa which belongs to the group of medicines called Erythropoiesis-stimulating agents. It is used to manage anemia caused due to chronic kidney disease (CKD), chemotherapy, anti-viral therapy (Ex. zidovudine), blood donation or due to any bone marrow disorders/cancers (such as myelodysplastic syndromes).

It can also be used to manage anemia in patients who are planning to undergo any major bone surgery (such as hip or knee replacement operations). It may also reduce the potential need for blood transfusion in cancer patients and in patients undergoing bone surgery or chemotherapy.

VINTOR 2000 INJECTION is suitable for use both in adults and in children. During management with VINTOR 2000 INJECTION your doctor will constantly monitor your blood pressure and iron levels in blood and will adjust the dose accordingly to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before receiving VINTOR 2000 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have high blood pressure, diabetes, obesity, breast cancer, head and neck cancer, fits, previous history of blood clots or if you are undergoing dialysis or any surgery as a precaution.

VINTOR 2000 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with recent heart attack or stroke. It is also not suitable for use in patients having severe uncontrollable high blood pressure and pure red aplastic anemia (a condition in which the bone marrow cannot produce RBC).

Inform your doctor before receiving VINTOR 2000 INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of receiving VINTOR 2000 INJECTION are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, fever, stuffy nose and sore throat. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Anemia in patients undergoing any major bone surgery (such as hip or knee replacement operations)
Need for blood transfusion in cancer patients and in patients undergoing bone surgery or chemotherapy

Uses Of VINTOR 2000 INJECTION

It is used in adults and in children to manage or reduce the chances of:

Anemia (low RBC in blood) caused due to chronic kidney disease, chemotherapy, anti-viral therapy (Ex. zidovudine), blood donation or any bone marrow disorders/cancers (such as myelodysplastic syndromes),
Anemia in patients undergoing any major bone surgery (such as hip or knee replacement operations)
Need for blood transfusion in cancer patients and in patients undergoing bone surgery or chemotherapy
mechanismOfAction:
How VINTOR 2000 INJECTION Works

VINTOR 2000 INJECTION is an Erythropoiesis-stimulating agent. Following administration, it stimulates the bone marrow to produce red blood cells. It contains a medicine called Epoetin Alfa which acts similar to the endogenous human protein called erythropoietin (a substance that stimulates bone marrow to produce red blood cells).

Therefore, it replaces the lost red blood cells (RBC) in the body of anaemic patients and in patients who are at risk of developing anemia due to chemotherapy, anti-viral therapy or bone marrow disorders.
usageDetails:
How to use VINTOR 2000 INJECTION

VINTOR 2000 INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously) or under the skin (subcutaneously). It can also be self-administered by the patient if instructed by the doctor. Carefully follow the instructions given by your doctor in case of self-administration.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

It is not known whether VINTOR 2000 INJECTION can pass through breast milk or not. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by VINTOR 2000 INJECTION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol before receiving VINTOR 2000 INJECTION.
VINTOR 2000 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients undergoing dialysis. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
VINTOR 2000 INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Talk to your doctor before receiving VINTOR 2000 INJECTION if you are allergic to Epoetin Alfa.

VINTOR 2000 INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart diseases (including recent heart attack). It should be used with caution in patients with other mild heart problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

VINTOR 2000 INJECTION should be used in children and in adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. It is not suitable for use in young babies (aged below 1 year). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.
VINTOR 2000 INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

VINTOR 2000 INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have Pure Red cell aplasia (a condition in which bone marrow cannot produce red blood cells)
Have uncontrollable high blood pressure
Have severe disorders of blood vessels in the body
Had stroke recently
Cannot have blood transfusion with your own blood
Cannot take blood thinning medicines

Before receiving VINTOR 2000 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have:

Have diabetes
Are obese or overweight
Have a previous history of blood clots in the body
Are bed-ridden for a prolonged period
Have or ever suffered a high blood pressure
Have or ever had epilepsy (fits)
Have anemia of other causes not listed above
Have porphyria (a rare inherited blood disorder)
Have head and neck cancer, breast cancer

Introduction About TRANEXAVAG INJECTION

TRANEXAVAG INJECTION contains Tranexamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antifibrinolytics. It is used in the management of bleeding in conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding in women, gastrointestinal bleeding (bleeding in digestive tract, anywhere from the throat to rectum), bleeding due to thrombolytic therapy (medicine that is used to breakdown blood clots) and after having surgeries (such as ear, nose, throat, prostate gland, urinary tract, gynecological, abdominal or heart surgery) in adults and children above one year of age.

TRANEXAVAG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney impairment, blood clotting disorder or consumption coagulopathy (condition affecting the blood’s ability to clot and stop the bleeding) or history of seizures (fits). Your doctor may recommend you to take relevant tests to understand your existing condition.

Before receiving TRANEXAVAG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you had or have blood in the urine, are at risk of having a blood clot, excessive clotting or bleeding throughout the body (disseminated intravascular coagulation).

TRANEXAVAG INJECTION is not recommended for use in the first trimester of pregnancy and in breast-feeding women. It should be used with caution in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor. TRANEXAVAG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially in patients with the evidence of renal failure.

The most common side effects of receiving TRANEXAVAG INJECTION are nausea or vomiting and diarrhea. Inform your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

name: Botrostat Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BOTROSTAT TABLET

BOTROSTAT TABLET contains Etamsylate, which belongs to the group of medicines called antihemorrhagic drugs. It helps to manage bleeding. It reduces bleeding time and blood loss. BOTROSTAT TABLET is used before, during and after a delicate surgical procedure involving the urinary system, eyes, nose, throat etc, to manage bleeding.

It also helps to reduce bleeding in or from the nose (epistaxis), gums (gingivitis), urine (haematuria), stools (melena), etc. BOTROSTAT TABLET is also recommended for use by females to manage spotting (bleeding between menstrual periods) and excessive or prolonged bleeding during menstruation (with or without an intrauterine device present).

Before starting with BOTROSTAT TABLET, your doctor may advise you to take tests to verify the cause of the bleeding. If you are a woman/girl suffering from excessive menstrual bleeding, your doctor will do a thorough gynaecological check-up before therapy.

BOTROSTAT TABLET is not recommended to take if you are suffering from porphyria (a blood disorder where the synthesis of haemoglobin is not proper). BOTROSTAT TABLET must be taken with caution if you are suffering from any kidney, liver or heart diseases.

BOTROSTAT TABLET is also generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children. The most common side effects of taking BOTROSTAT TABLET are nausea, vomiting, headache, stomach pain, tiredness, body rashes, loose motions etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How BOTROSTAT TABLET Works

BOTROSTAT TABLET contains Etamsylate, which is an antihemorrhagic medicine that helps to stop bleeding. It works by increasing blood cells (platelets) ability to stick together and aids in the formation of blood clots during the first stage of haemostasis (the body's normal response to an injury that stops bleeding). Additionally, it decreases blood loss at the site by increasing blood capillary resistance.
usageDetails:
How to use BOTROSTAT TABLET

Take BOTROSTAT TABLET exactly as advised by your doctor. Generally, it is advised to swallow the medicine with a glass of water Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Stop taking BOTROSTAT TABLET and contact your doctor if you notice any of the following:

Clots in blood vessels (thromboembolism)
Getting infections more likely (due to reduced count of white blood cells)
Reduction in blood count of platelets which increases the risk of bleeding and bruising
Increased frequency of getting infections
Allergic reactions
Fever

Interactions

A. Drug–drug interactions:

Before taking BOTROSTAT TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking, have taken or might take any other medicines, including prescription, non-prescription or any other herbal medicines.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more of BOTROSTAT TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.
